description.summary: You open a rift between dimensions that summons your avatar
description.value: You open a rift between dimensions that summons your avatar. Treat this as if you had summoned your avatar normally, except that it only remains with you for the duration of this spell. While summoned in this way, your avatar can be sent back to its home plane by dispel. If you cast this spell while your avatar is already on your plane, this spell has no effect. This spell allows you to summon your avatar even if it has been returned to its home plane due to damage.
